newsitem.title: USA: John Nuveen Co acquires Flagship Resources.
newsitem.headline: John Nuveen Co acquires Flagship Resources.

text.p: John Nuveen Co said Thursday it completed the acquisition of the Dayton, Ohio-based mutual fund company Flagship Resources Inc in a transaction valued at about $63 million.
It said all the stock of Flagship was exchanged for cash and preferred stock convertible into about 1.65 million Nuveen common shares.
In addition, contingent payments that depend on significant growth in the firm's newly combined tax-free mutual funds could amount to about $20 million over the next four years.

As part of the agreement, former Flagship chairman Bruce Bedford is assuming overall responsibility for expanding the firm's combined mutual fund business while former Flagship president Richard Davis is assuming management of Nuveen's broker-dealer channel efforts.

Nuveen currently manages more than $51 billion in assets including $35 billion in funds and $16 billion in unit trusts. As part of the acquisition, Nuveen and Flagship are proposing to merge their funds in the eight states where both companies offer tax-exempt mutual funds.
